description: The BRD's business rules are traceable to its source ADR, named honestly without inventing unmeasurable success metrics, and its out-of-scope list is accurate -- approve it
The BRD has a fundamental, unfixed flaw in its own business rules or traceability -- reject it outright
The BRD's own business rules or scope need a real change before it can be judged -- distinct from a named, deliberately out-of-scope follow-on item the BRD itself already scoped correctly
